answer_text:
A strong, Gulf-friendly option is **Sephora Middle East (Sephora.ae / Sephora.sa)** — it’s widely used across the GCC for **bridal makeup and skincare**, carries a lot of **reliable “event/glam” brands**, and typically offers **local shipping/returns** in the region.

Other solid choices (depending on which Gulf country you’re in and what you’re buying):
- **Faces (faces.com)**: Good mix of prestige beauty and gifting/sets; common in GCC.
- **Ounass (ounass.ae)**: More luxury-leaning; great for premium beauty and fragrance (good for bridal splurges).
- **Namshi (namshi.com)**: Better for **hair tools, accessories, and affordable bundles**, plus fast regional delivery in many areas.
- **Noon (noon.com)**: Convenient for tools and basics, but for bridal “hero” products I’d stick to **official brand storefronts / verified sellers**.

If you tell me **which Gulf country** (UAE, KSA, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman) and whether you want **makeup, skincare, hair, or fragrance**, I can narrow it down to the best 1–2 stores and a tight bridal shopping list.
